title: Dominic and the Archive
author: Ada Iversen
blurb: Lena Sterling, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
